mentions.name: Gnothi
mentions.description: An LLM-powered offline journaling and mindfulness app that draws on ancient philosophy, designed to keep each journaling session fresh and interesting and help sustain the journaling habit.
mentions.problem: The journaling habit can fade and sessions can become repetitive; the app nudges the habit along and keeps things fresh every session.
mentions.source_excerpt: An LLM-powered 'offline' journaling/mindfulness app that draws on ancient philosophy. Designed it initially to help nudge my own habit along & keep things fresh/interesting every time I sat down for a scribble-sesh.

evidence.value: An LLM-powered 'offline' journaling/mindfulness app that draws on ancient philosophy. Designed it initially to help nudge my own habit along & keep things fresh/interesting every time I sat down for a scribble-sesh.
